blocker.why: l9.evidence-bundle/v1 is produced ONLY by the authenticated GitHub acquisition path, and build-feedback-event requires one as --evidence-bundle. This surface holds no GitHub credential the resolver's own transport can use: `gh api` succeeds here through a credential supplied outside the repository's control, which the resolver cannot consume.
blocker.not_worked_around: Constructing CIRunEvidence/FailedJob by hand to synthesise an evidence bundle was rejected: the contract forbids a hand-authored event as proof of this seam, and it would have manufactured the producer's own input.
blocker.classification: credentials - the Layer 2 contract's named condition for partial

resolver_producer_stage_1.note: Real resolver code projected the real Core-driven SDK FindingBundle onto l9.sdk-knowledge-document/v1. This is the resolver-side input build-feedback-event needs.

intelligence_consumer_accepts_real_produ.note: This is the SDK -> Intelligence ingestion path, NOT the resolver -> Intelligence seam. It proves Intelligence's real ingestion code accepts real producer output; it is explicitly NOT a substitute for the blocked resolver feedback path.

idempotency.evidence: Re-ingesting the identical bundle returned status=duplicate with the SAME record_id (cr_9584d55d...) and ledger_sequence=2. verify-store reports status=valid, ledger_entries=2, record_count=1, duplicates=1 - the append-only ledger recorded the delivery without creating a second corpus record.

pseudonymisation_enforced.evidence: Intelligence refused to ingest until L9_INTELLIGENCE_PSEUDONYM_KEY and L9_INTELLIGENCE_PATH_KEY were both set, stating the corpus would otherwise partition by producer. Repository identity is pseudonymised, never stored raw.
